verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment, such as test API keys or a separate non-production endpoint, that isolates experimentation from production data. Studio lets users test workflows on real documents before deploying a Pipeline ID, and a free tier and sample files exist. Those are adjacent pre-deployment testing aids, not an isolated sandbox environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
